repositories.description: A command-line knowledge system with snapshots, recovery, and safe operations.

documents.content:
---
type: spec
---
# Exact Snapshot Resolution

Queries resolve one full commit SHA and never substitute another branch snapshot.

정확한 커밋 SHA 하나만 선택하며 다른 브랜치 결과로 대체하지 않습니다.

Constraint: a missing exact manifest is an error; the journal term is only related context.

---
type: spec
---
# Exclusive Store Writer

Only one ingest or repair process may mutate the canonical store at a time.

저장소를 바꾸는 ingest 또는 repair 프로세스는 동시에 하나만 실행됩니다.

Constraint: a live owner returns busy rather than being stolen; journal recovery is related.

---
type: spec
---
# Ingest Transaction Journal

An ingest journal records phases before and after manifest publication so crashes remain observable.

Ingest 저널은 manifest 공개 전후 단계를 기록하여 장애 뒤에도 상태를 확인하게 합니다.

Constraint: precommit residue is never finalized as committed; writer lock coordinates mutation.

---
type: spec
---
# Manifest Union Rebuild

Rebuild writes the exact union referenced by every snapshot manifest and removes unknown store records.

재구축은 모든 snapshot manifest가 참조하는 정확한 합집합만 기록하고 orphan을 제거합니다.

Constraint: verification completes before atomic promotion; repair action is a related escape hatch.

---
type: spec
---
# Provider-Aware Embedding Cache

Embedding cache keys include the provider, model, version, and input content.

임베딩 캐시 키에는 provider, model, version, 입력 내용이 포함됩니다.

Constraint: a changed provider contract cannot reuse an incompatible vector; ranking consumes the vectors.

---
type: spec
---
# Hybrid Retrieval Scoring

Search combines vector similarity and keyword evidence with a fixed alpha score.

검색은 고정 alpha 점수로 vector 유사도와 keyword 근거를 혼합합니다.

Constraint: ranking is deterministic for an exact snapshot; context budget chooses after ranking.

---
type: spec
---
# Context Token Budget

Context selection stops before the configured token budget is exceeded.

컨텍스트 선택은 설정된 token budget을 넘기기 전에 멈춥니다.

Constraint: selected chunks retain snapshot provenance; hybrid ranking supplies candidates.

---
type: spec
---
# Secret Sanitization

Secrets are masked before artifacts, logs, or index records are persisted.

비밀 값은 artifact, log, index record에 저장되기 전에 마스킹됩니다.

Constraint: redaction is irreversible in durable output; repair must not reveal a key.

---
type: spec
---
# Reviewed Artifact Binding

A reviewed artifact is projected into a snapshot and bound to one committed HEAD during finalization.

검토된 artifact는 snapshot에 투영되고 finalization에서 하나의 committed HEAD에 바인딩됩니다.

Constraint: optimistic updatedAt conflicts fail closed; journal retry is idempotent.

---
type: spec
---
# Explicit Repair Actions

Repair plans are read-only and apply only named safe actions under the writer lock.

Repair plan은 읽기 전용이며 writer lock 아래에서 명시된 안전 action만 적용합니다.

Constraint: no action runs implicitly; manifest rebuild is an explicit action.

---
type: spec
---
# Package Release Verification

A release verifies the packed CLI before publishing to npm.

배포는 npm publish 전에 packed CLI를 검증합니다.

Constraint: the smoke command uses the tarball, not a local source checkout; manifest metadata is unrelated.

---
type: spec
---
# Read-Only MCP Projection

MCP tools expose queryable projections without mutating the repository cache.

MCP 도구는 repository cache를 쓰지 않고 조회 가능한 projection만 제공합니다.

Constraint: read commands never trigger recovery; context output stays read-only.

queries.en: How can a lookup require the committed revision instead of falling back to another branch?
queries.ko: 다른 브랜치 대신 지정한 커밋의 인덱스만 선택하려면 어떻게 하나요?
queries.mixed-noisy: HEAD exact 스냅샷 pls unrelated branch 말고

queries.en: What prevents two store mutations from racing during ingestion?
queries.ko: 동시에 두 ingest가 저장소를 쓰지 못하게 하는 장치는 무엇인가요?
queries.mixed-noisy: 동시 ingest race writer lock 어떻게

queries.en: Where is ingest progress recorded so a crash can be inspected safely?
queries.ko: 장애가 난 뒤 ingest 진행 상태를 안전하게 확인하는 기록은 어디에 있나요?

queries.en: How do we reconstruct storage from all published snapshots while deleting stray records?
queries.ko: 공개된 모든 스냅샷으로 저장소를 다시 만들고 고아 레코드를 없애려면 어떻게 하나요?

queries.en: Which identity fields keep cached embeddings safe when the model provider changes?
queries.ko: 모델 제공자가 바뀔 때 임베딩 캐시를 안전하게 구분하는 키는 무엇인가요?

queries.en: How are lexical evidence and vector similarity combined for search order?
queries.ko: 검색 순서에서 키워드 근거와 벡터 유사도는 어떻게 합쳐지나요?

queries.en: How can a context response stay under its allowed token limit?
queries.ko: 컨텍스트 응답이 허용된 토큰 한도를 넘지 않게 하려면 어떻게 하나요?

queries.en: When must API credentials be sanitized before durable records are written?
queries.ko: 지속 저장 전에 API 비밀 값을 언제 마스킹해야 하나요?
queries.mixed-noisy: API key 저장 전에 mask plz

queries.en: At which point does a reviewed artifact receive its committed revision binding?
queries.ko: 검토된 artifact는 어느 단계에서 커밋 HEAD와 연결되나요?

queries.en: Which repair workflow requires a named safe action before changing state?
queries.ko: 상태를 바꾸기 전에 명시된 안전 action을 요구하는 repair 절차는 무엇인가요?

queries.en: What should be tested before an npm package is published?
queries.ko: npm 패키지를 publish하기 전에 무엇을 검증해야 하나요?

queries.en: How should MCP access knowledge without creating cache writes?
queries.ko: MCP가 캐시 쓰기 없이 지식을 조회하려면 어떻게 해야 하나요?
queries.mixed-noisy: MCP tool cache write 하면 안됨

repositories.description: A transactional commerce service covering orders, payments, and customer operations.

documents.content:
---
type: spec
---
# Order Transition Rules

Orders move through validated states such as paid and shipped without illegal jumps.

주문은 paid, shipped 같은 검증된 상태를 거치며 잘못된 점프를 허용하지 않습니다.

Constraint: every transition checks the current state; payment retry is related.

---
type: spec
---
# Idempotent Payment Requests

A payment retry uses one idempotency key so a network retry cannot charge twice.

결제 재시도는 하나의 idempotency key를 사용하여 중복 청구를 막습니다.

Constraint: the original response is replayed for the same key; dead-letter replay is related.

---
type: spec
---
# Reservation Expiry

Reserved inventory is released after its TTL unless checkout confirms the order.

예약된 재고는 checkout이 주문을 확정하지 않으면 TTL 뒤에 해제됩니다.

Constraint: release is idempotent; order state remains the related term.

---
type: spec
---
# Partial Refund Eligibility

Partial refunds require a captured payment and an eligible fulfilled line item.

부분 환불은 캡처된 결제와 환불 가능한 배송 완료 항목을 요구합니다.

Constraint: refundable amount never exceeds the settled amount; tax rounding is related.

---
type: spec
---
# Manual Fraud Review

High fraud scores enter a manual review queue before fulfillment proceeds.

높은 fraud score는 배송 전에 수동 검토 queue로 들어갑니다.

Constraint: reviewers record a reason and decision; customer consent is related.

---
type: spec
---
# Transactional Outbox Delivery

An outbox row is committed with the business change and published asynchronously.

Outbox row는 업무 변경과 함께 commit되고 비동기로 publish됩니다.

Constraint: delivery retries preserve event identity; observability traces are related.

---
type: spec
---
# Shipping Deadline

Same-day shipping eligibility uses a timezone-aware cutoff and service-level target.

당일 배송 자격은 timezone을 고려한 cutoff와 서비스 수준 목표를 사용합니다.

Constraint: orders after cutoff move to the next service window; inventory reservation is related.

---
type: spec
---
# Tax Rounding Sequence

Tax is calculated per line before totals are summed using the configured currency rule.

세금은 설정된 통화 규칙으로 line별 계산 후 합계를 더합니다.

Constraint: invoices retain the rounding inputs; refund policy is related.

---
type: spec
---
# Promotion Precedence

Coupon rules define which promotion wins when stacking would conflict.

쿠폰 규칙은 중첩 충돌이 생길 때 어떤 promotion이 우선하는지 정의합니다.

Constraint: an order records the chosen rule; tax rounding is related.

---
type: spec
---
# Marketing Consent Retention

Marketing consent records capture grant and revoke events with retention limits.

마케팅 동의 기록은 보존 기한과 함께 동의 및 철회 이벤트를 남깁니다.

Constraint: revoked consent stops new campaigns; fraud review is related.

---
type: spec
---
# Failed Event Replay

Dead-letter events are replayed with deduplication after the cause is corrected.

Dead-letter 이벤트는 원인을 수정한 뒤 중복 제거와 함께 재처리됩니다.

Constraint: replay never repeats a completed side effect; payment idempotency is related.

---
type: spec
---
# Checkout Observability

Checkout traces expose latency, errors, and p95 SLO alerts across services.

Checkout trace는 서비스 전반의 latency, 오류, p95 SLO alert를 보여 줍니다.

Constraint: an alert links a trace ID, not payment data; outbox events are related.

queries.en: What validation stops an order from skipping directly between lifecycle states?
queries.ko: 주문이 라이프사이클 상태를 건너뛰지 못하게 검증하는 방법은 무엇인가요?
queries.mixed-noisy: order paid shipped 상태 jump 금지

queries.en: How does a payment retry avoid creating a second charge?
queries.ko: 결제 요청을 재시도해도 이중 청구가 생기지 않게 하려면 어떻게 하나요?

queries.en: When does temporarily held stock return to available inventory?
queries.ko: 임시로 확보한 재고는 언제 사용 가능 재고로 돌아가나요?

queries.en: Which conditions allow refunding only part of a completed purchase?
queries.ko: 완료된 구매의 일부만 환불할 수 있는 조건은 무엇인가요?

queries.en: Which risk signal sends a checkout to a human review queue?
queries.ko: 어떤 위험 신호가 결제를 사람 검토 대기열로 보내나요?

queries.en: How can a database change and later event delivery stay transactionally connected?
queries.ko: 데이터베이스 변경과 이후 이벤트 전달을 트랜잭션으로 연결하려면 어떻게 하나요?

queries.en: What determines whether an order meets the same-day delivery deadline?
queries.ko: 주문이 당일 배송 마감 시간을 충족하는지 무엇으로 판단하나요?

queries.en: Should tax be rounded for each item or only after calculating the total?

queries.en: How are conflicting coupons ordered when more than one discount is eligible?

queries.en: How long are marketing opt-in and revocation records retained?
queries.ko: 마케팅 동의와 철회 기록은 얼마나 오래 보관하나요?

queries.en: How can failed commerce messages be replayed without duplicating effects?
queries.ko: 실패한 상거래 메시지를 효과 중복 없이 다시 처리하려면 어떻게 하나요?

queries.en: Which signals reveal checkout latency and service-level breaches?
queries.ko: 체크아웃 지연과 서비스 수준 위반을 보여 주는 신호는 무엇인가요?

repositories.description: An operating handbook for planning, incidents, and collaborative team practices.

documents.content:
---
type: spec
---
# Measurable Quarterly Outcomes

Quarterly objectives use observable key results with owners and target dates.

분기 목표는 담당자와 목표 날짜가 있는 측정 가능한 key result를 사용합니다.

Constraint: outcomes are reviewed at quarter close; experiment guardrails are related.

---
type: spec
---
# Incident Severity Classification

Severity is assigned from customer impact, scope, and time-sensitive service loss.

심각도는 고객 영향, 범위, 시간 민감한 서비스 손실로 분류합니다.

Constraint: SEV1 opens an incident commander role; on-call handoff is related.

---
type: spec
---
# On-Call Shift Handoff

The outgoing engineer records open alerts, current mitigation, and pending decisions.

교대하는 엔지니어는 열린 alert, 현재 완화 조치, 보류 결정을 기록합니다.

Constraint: handoff names the next owner; incident severity is related.

---
type: spec
---
# Release Freeze Exceptions

A release freeze allows only approved hotfix exceptions with a named approver.

배포 동결 기간에는 지정된 승인자가 허용한 hotfix 예외만 가능합니다.

Constraint: exceptions include rollback evidence; decision record is related.

---
type: spec
---
# First-Week Onboarding

New hires receive access, a mentor, and a first-week checklist before production work.

신규 입사자는 프로덕션 작업 전에 권한, 멘토, 첫 주 체크리스트를 받습니다.

Constraint: access follows least privilege; support escalation is related.

---
type: spec
---
# Accessibility Review

Reviews test keyboard focus order and screen-reader labels before release.

검토는 배포 전에 키보드 focus 순서와 screen-reader label을 시험합니다.

Constraint: blockers have an owner and due date; localization parity is related.

---
type: spec
---
# Localization Parity

English source changes require a Korean translation parity check before publishing.

영문 원본 변경은 게시 전에 한글 번역 parity 검사를 요구합니다.

Constraint: locale owners approve terminology; accessibility review is related.

---
type: spec
---
# Architecture Decision Ownership

An ADR records the decision owner, rationale, alternatives, and consequences.

ADR은 결정 담당자, 근거, 대안, 결과를 기록합니다.

Constraint: a decision remains discoverable after the project changes; release freeze is related.

---
type: spec
---
# Experiment Safety Guardrails

Experiments define stop metrics and an escalation path before exposure increases.

실험은 노출을 늘리기 전에 중단 지표와 에스컬레이션 경로를 정의합니다.

Constraint: harmful movement pauses the experiment; quarterly outcomes are related.

---
type: spec
---
# Support Escalation

Customer support escalates a ticket with impact, evidence, and an engineering owner.

고객 지원은 영향, 근거, 엔지니어 담당자와 함께 ticket을 escalation합니다.

Constraint: status updates return to the customer channel; onboarding is related.

---
type: spec
---
# Operational Data Retention

Operational logs have a retention schedule and verified deletion process.

운영 log에는 보존 일정과 검증된 삭제 절차가 있습니다.

Constraint: legal holds pause deletion; postmortem evidence is related.

---
type: spec
---
# Postmortem Action Ownership

A postmortem action has one owner, a due date, and verification of completion.

회고 action에는 한 명의 담당자, 기한, 완료 검증이 있습니다.

Constraint: actions are reviewed until closed; data retention is related.

queries.en: How should a team express outcomes for the next quarter so progress is measurable?
queries.ko: 다음 분기의 성과를 측정 가능하게 표현하려면 어떻게 해야 하나요?

queries.en: What customer impact qualifies an operational event as the highest severity?
queries.ko: 어떤 고객 영향이 운영 사건을 가장 높은 심각도로 분류하게 하나요?

queries.en: What information must an engineer transfer at the end of an on-call shift?
queries.ko: 온콜 교대가 끝날 때 엔지니어가 전달해야 하는 정보는 무엇인가요?

queries.en: Who can approve an urgent deployment while normal releases are frozen?
queries.ko: 일반 배포가 동결된 동안 긴급 배포는 누가 승인할 수 있나요?

queries.en: Which access and support items belong in a new colleague's first week?
queries.ko: 신규 동료의 첫 주에 필요한 권한과 지원 항목은 무엇인가요?

queries.en: What should a release review check for keyboard users and screen readers?
queries.ko: 배포 검토에서 키보드 사용자와 스크린 리더를 위해 무엇을 확인해야 하나요?

queries.en: How do teams keep Korean content aligned when its English source changes?
queries.ko: 영문 원본이 바뀔 때 한글 콘텐츠를 동기화하려면 어떻게 하나요?
queries.mixed-noisy: i18n en source ko parity check

queries.en: Where are architectural alternatives, rationale, and accountable owners preserved?
queries.ko: 아키텍처 대안, 근거, 책임 담당자는 어디에 남겨야 하나요?

queries.en: Which safety rule should stop an experiment when users are harmed?
queries.ko: 사용자에게 해가 생길 때 실험을 멈추게 하는 안전 규칙은 무엇인가요?

queries.en: When should a support request move to engineering with customer evidence?
queries.ko: 고객 근거와 함께 지원 요청을 언제 엔지니어링으로 올려야 하나요?

queries.en: How are operational logs scheduled for retention and deletion?
queries.ko: 운영 로그의 보존과 삭제 일정은 어떻게 관리하나요?

queries.en: How do follow-up actions from an incident remain owned until verified?
queries.ko: 장애 후속 action이 검증될 때까지 담당을 유지하려면 어떻게 하나요?
